subject: CamtrapR can be used with photo management software MediaPro by PhaseOne

messages.author: 7d9411c72438f0a1
messages.subject: CamtrapR can be used with photo management software MediaPro by PhaseOne
parts:
Hello All,

For those interested, CamtrapR is capable of using the image management software MediaPro by PhaseOne. I mainly used it to batch rename file names to the date and time found in the metadata. They have since discontinued this software but just in case someone else needed to know, all you have to do is uncheck the box in MediaPro that says "Prefer Sidecar XMP over Embedded Metadata".

Best Regards,

Marcelo Jorge
